'''Ferrid''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. During the war in c. [[3665 BBY]], Ferrid managed to [[Theft of a Republic superweapon|steal a Republic superweapon]], but was soon captured and send to the [[Belsavis prison]]. Here, Ferrid stayed for 24 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] until he was freed by the [[Invasion of Belsavis|fighting]] during the [[Galactic War]] and with the help of a Sith spacer he moved to obtain his revenge on the Republic.
